# Step 09: GSVA 全通路活性评分

## 09.1 原生小鼠与人源同源 GSVA 矩阵

```{r}
ensure_module_result_layout("09_gsva")
mouse_gsva_table_dir <- "result/09_gsva/tables"
mouse_gsva_plot_dir <- "result/09_gsva/plots"
human_gsva_table_dir <- "result/09_gsva/human_ortholog/tables"
human_gsva_plot_dir <- "result/09_gsva/human_ortholog/plots"
ensure_dirs(mouse_gsva_table_dir, mouse_gsva_plot_dir, human_gsva_table_dir, human_gsva_plot_dir)

de_result <- restore_main_de_result(required = TRUE)
gsva_expr_source <- if (!is.null(gene_logcpm) && identical(colnames(gene_logcpm), colnames(gene_exp))) gene_logcpm else log2(gene_exp + 1)
gsva_expr_mat <- make_gene_symbol_matrix(gsva_expr_source, de_result)
gsva_group_factor <- factor(sample_info[colnames(gsva_expr_mat), "group"], levels = c(group1_label, group2_label))

mouse_gene_sets <- get_pathway_gene_set_bundle("mouse_native")
human_gene_sets <- get_pathway_gene_set_bundle("human_ortholog")

run_gsva_score_matrix <- function(expr_mat, gene_sets, min_size = 10, max_size = 500) {
  gene_sets <- filter_gene_sets_to_universe(gene_sets, rownames(expr_mat), min_size, max_size)
  if (length(gene_sets) == 0 || nrow(expr_mat) < 100 || ncol(expr_mat) < 4) {
    return(matrix(numeric(0), nrow = 0, ncol = ncol(expr_mat), dimnames = list(character(0), colnames(expr_mat))))
  }
  res <- if ("gsvaParam" %in% getNamespaceExports("GSVA")) {
    param <- GSVA::gsvaParam(
      exprData = as.matrix(expr_mat),
      geneSets = gene_sets,
      minSize = min_size,
      maxSize = max_size,
      kcdf = "Gaussian"
    )
    GSVA::gsva(param, verbose = FALSE)
  } else {
    GSVA::gsva(
      expr = as.matrix(expr_mat),
      gset.idx.list = gene_sets,
      method = "gsva",
      kcdf = "Gaussian",
      min.sz = min_size,
      max.sz = max_size,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
  }
  as.matrix(res)
}

write_gsva_matrix <- function(mat, path) {
  if (is.null(mat)) {
    mat <- matrix(numeric(0), nrow = 0, ncol = ncol(gsva_expr_mat), dimnames = list(character(0), colnames(gsva_expr_mat)))
  }
  write.table(mat, path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = NA)
}

run_gsva_diff <- function(mat, family_label) {
  diff_tbl <- run_limma_contrast_table(mat, gsva_group_factor, group1_label, group2_label)
  if (nrow(diff_tbl) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      pathway = character(),
      logFC = numeric(),
      AveExpr = numeric(),
      t = numeric(),
      P.Value = numeric(),
      adj.P.Val = numeric(),
      B = numeric(),
      family = character(),
      significant = logical(),
      direction = character(),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  diff_tbl %>%
    rownames_to_column("pathway") %>%
    mutate(
      family = family_label,
      # 每个来源、library 和 contrast 独立拟合并校正；nominal P 值仅作探索性筛选。
      significant = !is.na(P.Value) & P.Value < 0.05,
      direction = case_when(
        significant & logFC > 0 ~ paste0("higher_in_", group2_label),
        significant & logFC < 0 ~ paste0("higher_in_", group1_label),
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(P.Value, desc(abs(logFC)))
}

empty_gsva_matrix <- function() {
  matrix(numeric(0), nrow = 0, ncol = ncol(gsva_expr_mat), dimnames = list(character(0), colnames(gsva_expr_mat)))
}

score_bundle_libraries <- function(bundle, libraries) {
  if (nrow(gsva_expr_mat) < 100 || ncol(gsva_expr_mat) < 4) {
    return(setNames(lapply(libraries, function(x) empty_gsva_matrix()), libraries))
  }
  setNames(lapply(libraries, function(x) run_gsva_score_matrix(gsva_expr_mat, bundle$libraries[[x]])), libraries)
}

mouse_libraries <- c("Mouse_MH", "Mouse_KEGG", "Mouse_Reactome", "Mouse_M5")
human_libraries <- c("Human_Hallmark", "Human_KEGG_Legacy", "Human_Reactome", "Human_C5")
mouse_gsva <- score_bundle_libraries(mouse_gene_sets, mouse_libraries)
human_gsva <- score_bundle_libraries(human_gene_sets, human_libraries)

mouse_gsva_diff_list <- setNames(lapply(mouse_libraries, function(x) run_gsva_diff(mouse_gsva[[x]], x)), mouse_libraries)
human_gsva_diff_list <- setNames(lapply(human_libraries, function(x) run_gsva_diff(human_gsva[[x]], x)), human_libraries)

mouse_gsva_differential <- bind_rows(mouse_gsva_diff_list, .id = "collection") %>%
  mutate(
    origin = "mouse_native",
    db_species = "MM",
    analysis_species = "Mus musculus",
    contrast = paste0(group2_label, " - ", group1_label),
    .before = 1
  )
human_gsva_differential <- bind_rows(human_gsva_diff_list, .id = "collection") %>%
  mutate(
    origin = "human_ortholog",
    db_species = "HS",
    analysis_species = "Mus musculus",
    contrast = paste0(group2_label, " - ", group1_label),
    .before = 1
  )

mouse_gsva_status <- data.frame(
  step = "gsva",
  status = if (nrow(gsva_expr_mat) < 100 || ncol(gsva_expr_mat) < 4) "skipped" else "ok",
  detail = paste(names(mouse_gsva), vapply(mouse_gsva, nrow, integer(1)), sep = "=", collapse = ";"),
  origin = "mouse_native",

)
human_gsva_status <- data.frame(
  step = "gsva",
  status = if (nrow(gsva_expr_mat) < 100 || ncol(gsva_expr_mat) < 4) "skipped" else "ok",
  detail = paste(names(human_gsva), vapply(human_gsva, nrow, integer(1)), sep = "=", collapse = ";"),
  origin = "human_ortholog",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

mouse_matrix_paths <- c(
  Mouse_MH = file.path(mouse_gsva_table_dir, "09_1_Mouse_MH_GSVA_matrix.tsv"),
  Mouse_KEGG = file.path(mouse_gsva_table_dir, "09_2_Mouse_KEGG_GSVA_matrix.tsv"),
  Mouse_Reactome = file.path(mouse_gsva_table_dir, "09_3_Mouse_Reactome_GSVA_matrix.tsv"),
  Mouse_M5 = file.path(mouse_gsva_table_dir, "09_4_Mouse_M5_GSVA_matrix.tsv")
)
human_matrix_paths <- c(
  Human_Hallmark = file.path(human_gsva_table_dir, "09_1_Human_Hallmark_GSVA_matrix.tsv"),
  Human_KEGG_Legacy = file.path(human_gsva_table_dir, "09_2_Human_KEGG_Legacy_GSVA_matrix.tsv"),
  Human_Reactome = file.path(human_gsva_table_dir, "09_3_Human_Reactome_GSVA_matrix.tsv"),
  Human_C5 = file.path(human_gsva_table_dir, "09_4_Human_C5_GSVA_matrix.tsv")

for (nm in names(mouse_matrix_paths)) write_gsva_matrix(mouse_gsva[[nm]], mouse_matrix_paths[[nm]])

write_csv_safe(mouse_gsva_differential, file.path(mouse_gsva_table_dir, "09_gsva_differential.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

write_csv_safe(human_gsva_differential, file.path(human_gsva_table_dir, "09_gsva_differential.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write_csv_safe(human_gsva_status, file.path(human_gsva_table_dir, "09_0_GSVA_status.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

make_leading_summary <- function(diff_tbl) {
  diff_tbl %>%
    filter(is.finite(P.Value)) %>%
    group_by(collection, direction) %>%
    arrange(P.Value, desc(abs(logFC)), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    ungroup()
}
mouse_gsva_leading_summary <- make_leading_summary(mouse_gsva_differential)
human_gsva_leading_summary <- make_leading_summary(human_gsva_differential)
write_csv_safe(mouse_gsva_leading_summary, file.path(mouse_gsva_table_dir, "09_9_leading_GSVA_pathway_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write_csv_safe(human_gsva_leading_summary, file.path(human_gsva_table_dir, "09_9_leading_GSVA_pathway_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

mouse_source_manifest <- mouse_gene_sets$manifest %>%

  filter(library %in% human_libraries) %>%

write_csv_safe(mouse_source_manifest, file.path(mouse_gsva_table_dir, "09_0_gene_set_source_manifest.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## 09.2 GSVA 图表

```{r}
build_gsva_heat_matrix <- function(gsva_list, leading_summary) {
  leading_summary$figure_significance <- figure_significance_values(
    leading_summary,
    pvalue_candidates = "P.Value",
    fdr_candidates = "adj.P.Val"
  )
  top_pathways <- leading_summary %>%
    arrange(figure_significance, desc(abs(logFC))) %>%
    slice_head(n = 30) %>%
    pull(pathway) %>%
    unique()
  do.call(rbind, lapply(gsva_list, function(x) x[rownames(x) %in% top_pathways, , drop = FALSE]))
}

plot_gsva_outputs <- function(gsva_list, leading_summary, heatmap_path, barplot_path, source_label) {
  heat_mat <- build_gsva_heat_matrix(gsva_list, leading_summary)
  if (nrow(heat_mat) >= 2) {
    heat_scaled <- safe_scale_rows(heat_mat)
    save_base_pdf_versions(
      primary = heatmap_path,
      width = 10,
      height = 10,
      expr = ComplexHeatmap::draw(
        ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
          heat_scaled,
          name = "z-score",
          col = heatmap_diverging_col_fun(heat_scaled),
          top_annotation = heatmap_group_annotation(sample_info[colnames(heat_scaled), "group"]),
          cluster_rows = TRUE,
          cluster_columns = TRUE,
          column_names_rot = 45,
          column_title = source_label
        )
      )
    )
  }
  if (nrow(leading_summary) > 0) {
    bar_tbl <- leading_summary
    bar_tbl$figure_significance <- figure_significance_values(
      bar_tbl,
      pvalue_candidates = "P.Value",
      fdr_candidates = "adj.P.Val"
    )
    bar_tbl <- bar_tbl %>%
      group_by(collection) %>%
      arrange(figure_significance, desc(abs(logFC)), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
      slice_head(n = 8) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(pathway_label = factor(paste(collection, pathway, sep = " | "), levels = rev(unique(paste(collection, pathway, sep = " | ")))))
    bar_plot <- ggplot(bar_tbl, aes(x = pathway_label, y = logFC, fill = collection)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.75) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = resolve_enrichment_category_colors(bar_tbl$collection, "GSEA")) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(source_label, ": differential GSVA pathway activities"),
        x = NULL,
        y = paste0(group2_label, " - ", group1_label, " GSVA logFC")
      ) +
      theme_rnaseq_publication()
    save_plot_versions(bar_plot, barplot_path, width = 10, height = 9)
  }
  heat_mat
}

mouse_gsva_heat_mat <- plot_gsva_outputs(
  mouse_gsva,
  mouse_gsva_leading_summary,
  file.path(mouse_gsva_plot_dir, "09_10_Mouse_native_GSVA_pathway_activity_heatmap.pdf"),

  "Mouse native"
)
```

## 09.3 GSVA 与 WGCNA 模块 eigengene 关联

```{r}
if ((!exists("me_df") || nrow(me_df) == 0) && file.exists(cache_12_wgcna_path)) {
  wgcna_state <- readRDS(cache_12_wgcna_path)
  me_df <- wgcna_state$me_df %||% data.frame()
}

run_gsva_module_correlation <- function(heat_mat, csv_path, pdf_path, source_label) {
  cor_long <- data.frame()
  if (exists("me_df") && is.data.frame(me_df) && nrow(me_df) > 0 && nrow(heat_mat) >= 2) {
    module_cols <- grep("^Module_", colnames(me_df), value = TRUE)
    common_samples <- intersect(colnames(heat_mat), me_df$sample)
    if (length(module_cols) >= 1 && length(common_samples) >= 4) {
      module_mat <- t(as.matrix(me_df[match(common_samples, me_df$sample), module_cols, drop = FALSE]))
      colnames(module_mat) <- common_samples
      pathway_mat <- heat_mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
      cor_mat <- cor(t(module_mat), t(pathway_mat), use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
      cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
        rownames_to_column("Module") %>%
        pivot_longer(-Module, names_to = "pathway", values_to = "correlation") %>%
        mutate(source = source_label, .before = 1) %>%
        arrange(desc(abs(correlation)))
      write_csv_safe(cor_long, csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
      save_base_pdf_versions(
        primary = pdf_path,
        width = 10,
        height = 8,
        expr = ComplexHeatmap::draw(
          ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
            cor_mat,
            name = "r",
            col = heatmap_diverging_col_fun(cor_mat, midpoint = 0),
            cluster_rows = TRUE,
            cluster_columns = TRUE,
            column_title = source_label
          )
        )
      )
    }
  }
  if (nrow(cor_long) == 0) {
    write_csv_safe(data.frame(status = "skipped_wgcna_eigengene_or_gsva_matrix_unavailable", source = source_label), csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
  }
  cor_long
}

mouse_gsva_module_cor_long <- run_gsva_module_correlation(
  mouse_gsva_heat_mat,
  file.path(mouse_gsva_table_dir, "09_12_Mouse_native_GSVA_WGCNA_module_correlation.csv"),
  file.path(mouse_gsva_plot_dir, "09_13_Mouse_native_GSVA_WGCNA_module_correlation_heatmap.pdf"),
  "Mouse native"
)
human_gsva_module_cor_long <- run_gsva_module_correlation(
  human_gsva_heat_mat,
  file.path(human_gsva_table_dir, "09_12_Human_ortholog_GSVA_WGCNA_module_correlation.csv"),
  file.path(human_gsva_plot_dir, "09_13_Human_ortholog_GSVA_WGCNA_module_correlation_heatmap.pdf"),
  "Human MSigDB HS->Mus musculus ortholog"
)
```
